AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#362 @ 73dbefbcbe97544710058dcab176ea8713654042 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

A/B/C = 0/1/1

Independent T4 delta lens: AUD-SOL-H46D-119, agent 119.

### Prior findings and evidence applicability

**B-362-6 closes.** The hook now checks its captured generation after both pre-request storage awaits; the provider API keeps a per-request synchronous transform fence after token attachment and on retry; the screen silently closes the aborted action. Original Sol identity/grant/actual-transport probes, the builder's held-token/cloud control, and an additional real Axios 401-retry probe all pass. The additional probe checks unchanged/login/logout/logout-start for both Health Connect and Oura: stable retry sends twice; changed generation sends only the original request, never a retry under the new session. [Independent exact-top execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37235444130/job/111533494316).

**B-362-2 closes only through key enumeration, not through native mutation completion.** The prior held-enumeration and no-session/new-account probes now pass unchanged, but the remaining native-effect interleaving below still removes a newer grant. [Independent execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37235444130/job/111533494316).

G09: retain this model's prior H4 closures only where relevant source is unchanged; all six-path round-3 changes and every continuation in the hook/API/storage/UI were read independently. All four changed production blobs are identical at the tested H6 top, so its counterexample applies to this exact H4 source, not a later-piece implementation. [Previous Sol verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5983778382), [Round-3 source description](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5984342112), [Executed exact-top proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37235444130/job/111533494316).

Builder failing-before evidence was independently read: 10 behavioral failures / 35 passing controls; shared after-proof 257/257 and H4 replay 104/104. These close the named tested interleavings, not the additional native scheduling boundary. [Before](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37232924285), [After](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37233463017), [H4 replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37233484280).

### B-362-2 — Still partial: a native removal already invoked can delete a later Connect

**Location:** `src/services/health/onDeviceState.ts:117-120,175-177,199-204`; both hook paths call this helper at `src/hooks/useWearableConnections.ts:168-181`. [Round-3 implementation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5984342112).

The sequence check and invocation of `removeMany` are synchronous, but the actual removal is asynchronous. The assertion that storage applies JS calls in order is unsupported on the pinned Android implementation: AsyncStorage **3.1.1** defaults to legacy storage, whose `multiSet` and `multiRemove` each independently `launch` on `Dispatchers.IO`; separate Room transactions serialize database work when entered, not these JS invocation times. The probe reads and validates that installed implementation in CI. [Dependency applicability check and execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37235444130/job/111533494316).

**Concrete counterexample:** begin old retirement, let the final sequence check pass and native removal be invoked, pause that removal before its database effect, complete a newer authorization write, then let the older removal commit. The actual helper deletes the newer `fresh-connection` grant: expected `fresh-connection`, received absent, in both own-person and no-readable-session all-person cleanup. Ordered-native and no-reconnect controls pass. This is a synthetic permitted-scheduler proof; no hardware reproduction or native build is claimed. [Two invariant failures / 310 passing controls and regressions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37235444130/job/111533494316).

Exact-H4 corroboration uses `73dbefbc` plus tests/lane only and independently opens the native-removal gate without awaiting the later grant, allowing a correct application queue to finish. It reproduces **the same two grant-loss failures / 84 passing tests**; pinned Android implementation check, ordered/no-reconnect controls, original Sol probes, actual transport and 401 retries all pass. [Exact-H4 proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37235614084/job/111533983588).

**Minimal fix rule:** serialize local grant writes and conditional source retirement at the application boundary through completion of native mutations, or use equivalent epoch-addressed/atomic conditional deletion. Keep the originating-account/current-grant checks, synchronous new-Connect intent reservation, rejection recovery and source-wide no-session default. No-JS-await plus an in-memory sequence does not order native effects. Add the held-native-removal cases to H5 and replay both lenses; the reusable revised probe opens the old removal gate independently of the newer write so a correct serialized implementation can finish. [Counterexample](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37235444130/job/111533494316), [Exact-H4 scheduler corroboration](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37235614084/job/111533983588).

### C-362-5 — Carried follow-up, not changed by this round

`HealthFitnessScreen.tsx:147-156,207-209,265-287,312-318`: RHR-only data still does not affect meaningful-data/loading/error/retry/refresh state. Fix rule: compose both queries and add secondary-only/error controls. Other lenses' already-routed Cs remain in the lane report; freeze applies. [Previous retained C](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5983778382).

### CI and operator disposition

Exact-head Typecheck/lint/test is green; Analyze checks are absent on this stacked base, not claimed green. Grandfathered size is 2,913, under its 3,000 ceiling. Independent top lane executes 24 suites: 23 pass / one native-order suite fails, **2 failed / 310 passed tests**; original Sol and replayed Opus probes pass. [H4 CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37233807134/job/111528832911), [Size/round](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5984342112), [Independent lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37235444130/job/111533494316).

Accept the explicit silent-abort and drop-on-logout defaults; they cause no newly identified harm. Recommended default: one narrowly scoped H4 native-order repair, tests in H5, restack H5/H6 and obtain fresh dual deltas. H1–H6 stays land-as-one with integrated main-based checks and separately authorized device/flag release gates; do not land the integrated top while B-362-2 is open. [Recorded defaults](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5984342112), [Landing boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/364#issuecomment-5975773365).
